results.content: # Sizing up Fernando Mendoza’s preseason debut, according to the rookie QB and his coach. — Fernando Mendoza did much to impress in his preseason debut. Mendoza led the Raiders down the field on his second possession, finishing the drive with his first professional touchdown (albeit in exhibition action), connecting with receiver Jack Bech in the end zone for a six-yard score. Finding poise to throw a touchdown a few plays after running into a sack also showed the resiliency that’s needed to play the position at this level. But at the end of an evening that served, in part, as a celebration of the franchise’s new era, he chose to focus on his faults. Subbing in after Cousins led the starters on a touchdown drive, Mendoza said he felt sped up on his first snaps. Mendoza was more interested in talking about his missed reads on his third drive — a three-and-out that concluded with a pair of incompletions — than his first professional touchdown pass.
